CompanyProfile.title: CompanyProfile
CompanyProfile.description: Represents a startup company's core information, financial inputs for valuation, and current deal terms.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CompanyProfile entity.

companyName.description: The official registered name of the company.

stage.description: The current stage of the company, influencing valuation metrics.

industry.description: The industry in which the company operates, affecting revenue multiples.

monthlyRevenue.description: The company's current monthly revenue in INR.

monthlyGrowthRatePct.description: The month-over-month revenue growth rate percentage.

monthlyBurnRate.description: The amount of cash the company spends each month beyond its revenue in INR.

cashInBank.description: The total cash reserves currently held by the company in INR.

totalCustomers.description: The total number of paying customers.

avgCustomerLTV.description: The average Lifetime Value of a customer in INR.

customerAcquisitionCost.description: The average cost to acquire a new customer in INR.

currentInvestmentAmount.description: The amount of investment being considered in the current funding round in INR.

currentEquityOfferedPct.description: The percentage of equity being offered to the investor in the current funding round.

esopPoolPct.description: The percentage of equity reserved for the Employee Stock Option Pool.

advisorEquityPct.description: The percentage of equity allocated to advisors.

coFounderEquityPct.description: The percentage of equity held by co-founders, excluding the primary founder/user.

liquidationExitPrice.description: The simulated exit or acquisition price for liquidation preference calculation in INR.

liquidationInvestorCapital.description: The total capital invested by investors for liquidation preference calculation in INR.

liquidationPreferenceMultiple.description: The multiple applied to investor capital for liquidation preference.

liquidationPreferenceType.description: The type of liquidation preference (non-participating or participating).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the company profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the company profile was last updated.

BerkusScore.title: BerkusScore
BerkusScore.description: Represents the five factors used in the Berkus Method valuation for a company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BerkusScore entry.

companyId.description: Reference to the CompanyProfile. (Relationship: CompanyProfile 1:N BerkusScore)

earlySalesTractionScore.description: Score for the 'Early Sales / Traction' factor (1-5).

SimulatedFundingRound.title: SimulatedFundingRound
SimulatedFundingRound.description: Represents a simulated future funding round for dilution analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SimulatedFundingRound entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the CompanyProfile. (Relationship: CompanyProfile 1:N SimulatedFundingRound)

roundName.description: The name of the simulated round (e.g., 'Series A', 'Series B').

investmentAmount.description: The simulated investment amount for this round in INR.

equityOfferedPct.description: The simulated percentage of equity offered in this round.

order.description: The display order of this simulated funding round.

Shareholder.title: Shareholder
Shareholder.description: Represents an individual or entity holding a percentage stake in the company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Shareholder entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the CompanyProfile. (Relationship: CompanyProfile 1:N Shareholder)

name.description: The name or entity name of the shareholder.

shareType.description: The type of ownership interest (e.g., common, preference, ESOP, DVR).

ownershipPercentage.description: The percentage of the company owned by the shareholder.

firestore.reasoning: The recommended Firestore data structure adopts a hierarchical, user-centric model, ensuring robust security, scalability, and debuggability in line with the core design principles and mandates. All application data for a founder (user) is nested under their unique user ID, starting with a top-level `users` collection.
